lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments traverse the torso. Spacing is predominantly equidistant across the central torso mass, with an average interval of approximately 4% of total body length between centers.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped topological split is observed on the 5th vertical line (counted anterior-to-posterior) at approximately 70% of the vertical distance from the dorsal line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1 and 2 (anterior) and lines 11 and 12 (posterior) are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso. Fragmented dashed segments are visible near the ventral-posterior boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, with a density of approximately 1 spot per 1500 pixels in that region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two primary spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, creating a semi-connected geometric line segment parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial chevron between the orbits, a singular white transverse patch on the ventral neck, and white patches on the carpal and tarsal regions of the limbs.
